open_points.subject: _connections_file
open_points.text: _connections_file: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return content validated strictly against = models.ConnectionsFile only when it is one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, in which no object repeats a member name, whose only member is objects, each key of objects the canonical lowercase hyphenated spelling of a UUID, and each value a ConnectionEntry with exactly its fields, each of its declared type without coercion; it MUST raise ValueError for any other content.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace the prose reference to the encoding required by the JSON standard with the name of an imported constant or closed model enumeration that supplies the accepted encoding policy.

open_points.subject: _subfolder
open_points.text: _subfolder: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return the value unchanged only when it is a string holding a non-empty relative path none of whose segments names the parent folder and which does not name the root itself, and MUST raise ValueError for any other value.
open_points.rule: Адрес, записанный без `=` — в обратных кавычках или словами, — не разыменовывается вовсе: до модели не доходит ни значение, ни символ, и она вынуждена значение сочинить.
open_points.question: Name the parent-folder segment through an imported constant or another permitted value path instead of describing the required path token only in words.
